relations.subject: Hermann Schlagintweit
relations.evidence: along with his brother Adolph, he published a scientific study of the Alps in 1846–1848. They established their reputation with the Untersuchungen über die physikalische Geographie der Alpen (1850)

relations.subject: Hermann Schlagintweit
relations.evidence: were afterwards joined by brother Robert, and jointly published Neue Untersuchungen über die physikalische Geographie und Geologie der Alpen in 1854.
